description:
Explain it once. Every AI knows it. cachly keeps your project's rules, decisions and fixes over MCP and gives them back in every session, for individuals, teams and companies. Hosted on EU servers; works with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Cline and Zed.

124 tools in total; 27 are listed by default (the rest run through one dispatcher, cachly_tool).

Setup that also writes the rule files your assistant reads: npx @cachly-dev/mcp-server@latest autopilot
